world_seed.visual_direction: steep vertical architecture, fog-shrouded cliffs, brass scales, and paper-laden couriers

institutions.name: The Ministry of Weights and Promises
institutions.mandate: Assess and tax the weight of all spoken promises.
institutions.decision_rule: Tax rate increases exponentially with the emotional gravity of the promise.
institutions.visible_output: Brass scales placed at every street corner and public square.

institutions.name: The Guild of Burdened Couriers
institutions.mandate: Transport unpaid or defaulted promises between households.
institutions.decision_rule: Prioritize delivery based on the physical weight of the transcribed promise.
institutions.visible_output: Couriers carrying heavy, glowing ledgers and iron lockboxes.

institutions.name: The Deep Archive
institutions.mandate: Store broken promises and extract residual value.
institutions.decision_rule: Promises are crushed into raw emotional energy when storage capacity reaches 90%.
institutions.visible_output: Plumes of colored smoke rising from the cliff base.

causal_links.trigger: Tax rate increases beyond affordable levels
causal_links.effect: Citizens default on promises, increasing the volume of unpaid promises
Couriers are overwhelmed, slowing down all deliveries

causal_links.trigger: Couriers fail to deliver promises on time
causal_links.effect: Public trust in the spoken word collapses
Ministry raises taxes to fund new storage facilities

stakeholder_groups.name: The Gilded Tongues
stakeholder_groups.goal: Keep tax rates low for commercial promises.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Control over the city's food supply.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Require couriers to enforce trade agreements.

stakeholder_groups.name: The Silent Majority
stakeholder_groups.goal: Abolish the tax on personal and emotional promises.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Mass protests and refusal to speak.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Rely on the Archive to forgive old debts.

stakeholder_groups.name: The Brotherhood of the Burden
stakeholder_groups.goal: Increase hazard pay and reduce maximum carry weights.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Ability to strike and halt all promise transfers.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Depend on the Ministry for their legal monopoly.

premise: A cliffside city taxes spoken promises by their weight, and couriers carry unpaid ones between households.
simulation_objective: Balance the economic weight of promises against the physical burden of the couriers and the emotional toll on the citizens.
economy_focus: Resource management of spoken words, debt transfer, and taxation.
exploration_focus: Navigating the vertical cliffside districts and uncovering hidden archives.
visual_style: Steampunk meets gothic verticality, with brass instruments, heavy ledgers, and perpetual fog.

item_catalog.name: Vial of Glowing Ink
item_catalog.description: Specialized ink used to transcribe promises. It glows brighter based on the emotional gravity of the words.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A small glass vial filled with a luminescent, swirling blue ink, sitting on a heavy wooden desk next to a quill.

item_catalog.name: Courier's Iron Lockbox
item_catalog.description: A heavy iron lockbox used by the Guild of Burdened Couriers to transport defaulted promises safely.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A sturdy, riveted iron lockbox with a complex brass locking mechanism, resting on cobblestones in thick fog.

item_catalog.name: Sealed Debt Scroll
item_catalog.description: A transcribed promise that has defaulted, sealed with the wax crest of the Ministry.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A rolled parchment scroll sealed with heavy crimson wax bearing a scale insignia, surrounded by a faint magical aura.

item_catalog.name: Archive Smoke Filter
item_catalog.description: A brass breathing mask filter used to safely navigate the colored smoke plumes near the Deep Archive.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A steampunk-style brass respirator filter with fine mesh and leather straps, slightly tarnished.

item_catalog.name: Silence Warden Badge
item_catalog.description: A heavy brass badge worn by Silence Wardens, granting authority to assess and tax spoken words on the spot.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A polished brass badge shaped like a pair of lips sewn shut, pinned to a dark leather coat.

item_catalog.name: Blank Heavy Ledger
item_catalog.description: A thick, leather-bound ledger with brass reinforced corners, used for recording commercial promises.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A massive, thick book bound in dark leather with brass corner protectors and a heavy clasp.

item_catalog.name: Emotional Residue Crystal
item_catalog.description: A crystallized shard of raw emotional energy extracted from crushed promises at the Deep Archive.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A jagged, glowing purple crystal shard radiating a faint, melancholic light, held in a brass caliper.

item_catalog.name: Courier Hazard Token
item_catalog.description: A stamped brass token issued by the Brotherhood of the Burden to track hazard pay for heavy deliveries.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A small, octagonal brass coin stamped with the image of a bent back carrying a heavy box.

item_catalog.name: Gilded Lozenge
item_catalog.description: A soothing throat lozenge favored by wealthy merchants to keep their voices clear for important negotiations.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A small, golden-colored hard candy wrapped in wax paper, resting on a silver tray.

item_catalog.name: Silent Majority Gag
item_catalog.description: A simple cloth gag worn by poor citizens during protests to symbolize their refusal to speak and be taxed.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A strip of rough, dark grey cloth tied in a knot, slightly frayed at the edges.

item_catalog.name: Commercial Tax Exemption
item_catalog.description: A rare, highly sought-after certificate granting temporary tax relief for commercial promises.
item_catalog.image_prompt: An ornate parchment document covered in complex bureaucratic stamps and glowing ink signatures.

item_catalog.name: Calibration Weight
item_catalog.description: A standard 1kg brass weight used to calibrate public scales and ensure accurate taxation.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A perfectly cylindrical brass weight with '1 KG' engraved on the top, polished to a high shine.

item_catalog.name: Sentinel Baton
item_catalog.description: A heavy iron baton carried by Archive Sentinels to protect the Deep Archive from desperate debtors.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A solid iron truncheon with a leather-wrapped grip and a brass pommel, looking well-used.

item_catalog.name: Perpetual Fog Lantern
item_catalog.description: A specialized lantern that cuts through the perpetual fog of Oathsedge, essential for couriers working late.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A tall, brass lantern emitting a piercing, focused beam of amber light through thick, swirling grey fog.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Steampunk gothic bureaucratic dystopia. Heavy, layered clothing suited for damp, foggy cliffside environments. Attire emphasizes burden, bureaucracy, and tarnished brass accents.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Dark slate grey with prominent tarnished brass accents.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Rigid, authoritative, top-heavy with thick coats.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Muted greys and browns, stained with dampness.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Hunched forward, burdened by heavy boxes or ledgers.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Richer dark tones with polished gold/brass accents.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Upright, slightly padded shoulders, wealthy but subdued.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Pitch black and dark grey with glowing blue ink stains.

default_rule.silhouette_notes: Hunched against the fog, thick dark grey outline.

visual_consistency_rules: All characters must have a thick dark grey outline for readability against fog.
Silhouettes should generally appear hunched or burdened.
Brass accents should be visible but tarnished, except for wealthy roles.
Clothing should appear heavy, layered, and damp.
Props like ledgers and lockboxes should be oversized for 64x64 readability.

visual_canon.lighting: diffuse, fog-filtered daylight with harsh, localized brass lantern spotlights

terrain.path: worn stone steps and brass grates

sprite_language.outline: thick dark grey outline for readability against fog
sprite_language.role_readability: couriers carry oversized ledgers/boxes, wardens wear brass masks

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: strict top-down orthographic 2D game art, bureaucratic dystopia cliffside city, wet slate, tarnished brass scales, dense fog, steampunk gothic architecture
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: strict top-down orthographic 2D game sprite, hunched figure, carrying heavy ledgers, brass accents, dark grey outline, flat lighting
